messages:
zoe: FYI onboarding sample app hit a weird repro: embed-batcher + token refresh => server returns vector_dim_mismatch on retry.

mike: which SDK and helper config?

zoe: Node @redwood/inference v0.8.8, helper: embed-batcher, batching.pad_to_multiple=4. Minimal payload:
```json
{"items":[{"id":"a","text":"hi"},{"id":"b","text":"bye"}],"batching":{"pad_to_multiple":4}}
```

zoe: Timeline: POST #1 -> 200, server model=open-embed-1024. Token refresh triggers and SDK retries by re-sending a padded batch. POST #2 -> 400 with error body: {"error":{"code":"vector_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 1024 got 1536"}}

tara: Python sampleapp OK?

zoe: Python v1.4.2 unaffected. Node seems to use a module-level fallback DIM when the error envelope lacks model info. Also saw cases where the retry encoder produced a different vec_len header (protobuf path).

darnell: Sounds like two failure modes: (A) fallback default dim used on error-retry instead of call-scoped dim, (B) encoder path mismatch on retry changing vec_len header. Fix plan: make embed-batcher record original target dim in per-call metadata and reuse it for retries; for encoders, validate computed vec_len matches float count before sending retry.

mike: can you attach raw request/response captures and open a GH issue? tag devex-embed-batcher and assign to @darnell.

zoe: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/789 with logs and a curl repro. Also added a quick workaround in README: set pad_to_multiple:1 or set REDWOOD_EMBED_ENCODER=stable-json.

ci-bot: Issue created: sampleapp#789 by zoe - "embed-batcher: retry uses fallback dim / encoder header mismatch leading to vector_dim_mismatch".

darnell: I'll draft a fix and add unit tests that simulate auth refresh + error envelope without model. Also add an integration test where server alternates between `vectors` and `data` envelopes to catch normalizer regressions.

zoe: thanks everyone, will monitor the GH issue. :thumbsup:
